SeoContent.title: Why Use WASM Media Tool?
SeoContent.desc: Most online converters require you to upload your personal videos or audio files to a third-party cloud server. WASM Media Tool operates entirely on your device using WebAssembly technology. Your files never leave your browser, ensuring absolute privacy and zero upload waiting times.
SeoContent.a1: Yes, 100% safe. All processing happens locally inside your browser memory sandbox. We do not store, track, or look at your media files.
SeoContent.a2: We run a compiled version of FFmpeg directly inside a web worker using WebAssembly and multi-threading, bringing native desktop-grade media conversion straight to your browser.
